eye_sources: YuNet2023mar fixed 2x; external pretrained detector; no CSA/recognition network
preprocessing_screen: training-gallery leave-self-out raw gray and adaptive Gabor cosine NN mean; top three geometries; no probe
deep_candidates: two Gabor supports on top three geometries, plus previous_frozen anchor (seven per seed)
inner_validation: 16 folds; each holds one gallery image for five classes; fit 75 images/40 classes => N-Nc=35; all 80 gallery images validated once
pure_PCA_inner: rank74 because centered PCA on75 images has rank<=74; final optimized rank<=74; fixed-paper comparison uses76 on80 images
selection: maximize six-method mean inner accuracy; per method optimize listed ranks/LDA dimension/PCA prefix; ties prefer earlier catalog/policy/case/dimension
shared_per_outer_seed: all six methods share chosen geometry, Gabor, metric, LDA scale/origin; each seed uses only its own gallery for selection
limitations: historical probes already observed; not a blind study
two gallery images/class limit inner task to one held-out image; small validation sample
source retention counts raw pixel locations, not semantic face information
YuNet preprocessing is a modern group convention, not a2008 CSA component
prefix_ties: Cosine distances clipped to [0,2]; first dimension uses cdist to resolve sign-only ties identically
execution_note: After seed20 selection, remaining independent seeds dispatched in three CPU workers; incomplete seed21 screening safely recomputed; candidate grid/objective unchanged
selection_snapshot_note: Snapshot captures the selection implementation used by workers; seed20 differed only in directory resume guard. Later source additions expose contrast/plot stages and fresh-output preparation; selection mathematics/grid remain identical.
